import importlib.util
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest


def _load_candidate():
    here = Path(__file__).resolve()
    roots = [here.parent, *here.parents]
    root = next((p for p in roots if (p / "model" / "hyperbolic.py").is_file()), None)
    if root is None:
        # Test runners may place this module outside the candidate tree.
        root = Path("stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_c117_global_sinkhorn_poincare").resolve()
    if not (root / "model" / "hyperbolic.py").is_file():
        raise ImportError("cannot locate candidate source tree")
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
    import torch
    from model.hyperbolic import project_ball, squared_distance, squared_distance_matrix
    from model.model import RQVAE
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    return torch, project_ball, squared_distance, squared_distance_matrix, RQVAE, SimpleNamespace


class GradientFlowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        (cls.torch, cls.project_ball, cls.distance, cls.distance_matrix,
         cls.RQVAE, cls.Namespace) = _load_candidate()

    def test_squared_distance_gradcheck_and_independent_finite_difference(self):
        torch = self.torch
        # Non-coincident interior points avoid the norm cusp at x == y.
        x = torch.tensor([[0.17, -0.11]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.08, 0.23]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        f = lambda a, b: self.distance(a, b, c=1.0)
        self.assertTrue(torch.autograd.gradcheck(f, (x, y), eps=1e-6, atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-4))
        analytic = torch.autograd.grad(f(x, y).sum(), x)[0][0, 0].item()
        h = 1e-6
        xp, xm = x.detach().clone(), x.detach().clone()
        xp[0, 0] += h
        xm[0, 0] -= h
        numeric = (f(xp, y.detach()).item() - f(xm, y.detach()).item()) / (2*h)
        self.assertGreater(abs(analytic), 1e-5)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(analytic, numeric, delta=2e-5)

    def test_matrix_operator_has_finite_nonzero_gradients_and_flat_limit(self):
        torch = self.torch
        x = torch.tensor([[0.12, 0.31], [-0.27, 0.08]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[0.21, -0.16], [-0.05, 0.28], [0.33, 0.09]], dtype=torch.double, requires_grad=True)
        curved = self.distance_matrix(x, y, c=1.0)
        direct = self.distance(x[:, None, :], y[None, :, :], c=1.0)
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(curved, direct, atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-10))
        flat = self.distance_matrix(x, y, c=0.0)
        oracle = 4.0 * ((x[:, None, :] - y[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(-1)
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(flat, oracle, atol=1e-12, rtol=1e-12))
        gx, gy = torch.autograd.grad(curved.sum(), (x, y))
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(gx).all() and torch.isfinite(gy).all())
        self.assertGreater(gx.norm().item(), 1e-6)
        self.assertGreater(gy.norm().item(), 1e-6)

    def test_projection_and_real_model_losses_reach_parameters(self):
        torch = self.torch
        v = torch.tensor([[2.0, 0.3], [-0.2, 0.1]], requires_grad=True)
        projected = self.project_ball(v, radius=0.9)
        projected.square().sum().backward()
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(v.grad).all())
        self.assertGreater(v.grad.norm().item(), 1e-5)
        self.assertLessEqual(projected.detach().norm(dim=-1).max().item(), 0.900001)

        torch.manual_seed(13)
        cfg = self.Namespace(hidden_sizes=(8,), codebook_num=2, codebook_size=(4, 4),
                             codebook_dim=3, dropout=0.0, curvature=1.0, radius=0.9)
        model = self.RQVAE(cfg, in_dim=5)
        with torch.no_grad():
            for cb in model.rq.codebooks:
                cb.copy_(torch.randn_like(cb) * 0.12)
        population = torch.randn(9, 5)
        model.refresh_assignment(population)
        batch = population[:6].clone().requires_grad_(True)
        total, recon, balance = model(batch, torch.arange(6))
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(total) and torch.isfinite(recon) and torch.isfinite(balance))
        self.assertGreater(recon.item(), 0.0)
        total.backward()
        enc_grad = sum((p.grad.norm().item() for p in model.encoder.parameters() if p.grad is not None), 0.0)
        code_grads = [p.grad for p in model.rq.codebooks]
        self.assertGreater(enc_grad, 1e-7)
        self.assertTrue(all(g is not None and torch.isfinite(g).all() for g in code_grads))
        self.assertTrue(all(g.norm().item() > 1e-8 for g in code_grads))
        self.assertIsNotNone(batch.grad)
        self.assertGreater(batch.grad.norm().item(), 1e-8)

    def test_negative_controls_expose_nan_and_graph_disconnection(self):
        torch = self.torch
        x = torch.tensor([[0.2, -0.1]], requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.1, 0.3]])
        disconnected = self.distance(x.detach(), y, c=1.0).sum()
        self.assertFalse(disconnected.requires_grad)
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            disconnected.backward()
        bad = self.distance(torch.tensor([[float("nan"), 0.1]]), y, c=1.0)
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(bad).all().item())
        # A finite objective is required to produce finite parameter gradients.
        z = torch.tensor([0.4], requires_grad=True)
        nan_loss = z * torch.tensor(float("nan"))
        nan_loss.backward()
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(z.grad).all().item())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
